Digital connectivity centers around the Chevrolet MyLink infotainment system with a 7.0-inch color touchscreen display, featuring Bluetooth phone and audio streaming, USB/iPod integration, SiriusXM Satellite Radio, Voice Recognition, OnStar 4G LTE with built-in Wi-Fi hotspot capability, and a standard 6-speaker audio system (or available Pioneer 9-speaker 250-watt premium audio system).Practicality and cargo space remain strong points for a compact sedan built on a 105.7-inch wheelbase. Paired with the naturally aspirated 3.6-liter V8, the gated manual places the driver at the center of every shift and every rise through the rev range.
